spec.name: TSI WPR Cross
spec.entry_long: crossabove(ema(21 * (close - donchian_high(high, 21)) / (donchian_high(high, 100.0) - donchian_low(low, 1)), 13) - ema(100.0 * (close - donchian_high(high, 14)) / (donchian_high(high, 14) - donchian_low(low, 14)), 25), ema(ema(100 * (close - donchian_high(high, 14)) / (donchian_high(high, 14) - donchian_low(low, 14)), 13) - ema(100 * (close - donchian_high(high, 14)) / (donchian_high(high, 14) - donchian_low(low, 14)), 25), 13))
spec.exit_long: crossbelow(ema(100 * (close - donchian_high(high, 14)) / (donchian_high(high, 14) - donchian_low(low, 14)), 13) - ema(100 * (close - donchian_high(high, 14)) / (donchian_high(high, 14) - donchian_low(low, 14)), 25), ema(ema(100 * (close - donchian_high(high, 14)) / (donchian_high(high, 14) - donchian_low(low, 14)), 13) - ema(100 * (close - donchian_high(high, 14)) / (donchian_high(high, 14) - donchian_low(low, 14)), 25), 13))
spec.notes: Williams %R is rebuilt as the Donchian stochastic of the 14-bar range and the TSI as the EMA(13)-EMA(25) spread of that oscillator with an EMA(13) signal; the bullish cross opens and the bearish cross closes. All lengths are explicit fallbacks because the parameters carry no values, the denominator can be zero in a flat range, and StartProtection/chart areas are unsupported.
